title: frames-devnet-0
announcements: frames-devnet-0 launches **24.09.2026 09:00 CEST** (Gloas from genesis). Frames fork (EL Bogota) at **epoch 19 — 24.09.2026 11:01:36 CEST**.

**Scope.** First devnet for [EIP-8141 Frame Transactions](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8141)
EL-only feature devnet: the EL activates **Bogota** at the Heze fork epoch while the CL side of Heze is suppressed (`FRAMES_ENABLED=true` in ethereum-genesis-generator)
Clients at genesis: geth, nethermind, reth (EL) + lighthouse (CL). ethrex follows once its `frames-devnet-0` image carries [ethrex PR-7305](https://github.com/lambdaclass/ethrex/pull/7305).
